meta.title: Women Pay Lower Airfares Than Men

paragraphs.text: Female employees consistently pay lower airfares than men do for the same flights because they tend to book earlier.

sentences.text: Female employees consistently pay lower airfares than men do for the same flights because they tend to book earlier.

analysis.senseInContext: 一贯地、始终如一地（说明不是偶然一次）
examples: She has consistently scored above 90. 她一直考 90 分以上。

more.roots: con-（共同）+ sist（站立）→ 始终站在一处 → 一致
more.confusables: consistent 形容词“一致的”；be consistent with 与……一致

analysis.translationLiteral: 女性员工在同样的航班上始终比男性支付更低的机票，因为她们倾向于更早订票。
analysis.translationNatural: 同一条航线，女员工买的机票总是比男同事便宜——因为她们订得更早。
analysis.structMarkup: 【Female employees】 _consistently pay_ ~lower airfares~ (than men do) (for the same flights) {because they tend to book earlier}.
analysis.structureSummary: 主谓宾结构 + 比较状语从句 + 原因状语从句

components.note: consistently 是频率副词，说明“一贯如此”
lower 是比较级形容词修饰 airfares
do 替代 pay lower airfares，避免重复
限定比较范围：同样的航班

components.part: because they tend to book earlier

clauses: than men do 是比较状语从句，do 是代动词，替代前文的 pay lower airfares。
because they tend to book earlier 是 because 引导的原因状语从句。
tend to do 表示习惯性倾向，比 will 更客观。

phrases.usage: airfare 可数，常用复数；同义：pay for tickets。
phrases.example: Travellers pay higher airfares during holidays. 假期期间旅客支付的机票更贵。

phrases.usage: 表示统计意义上的普遍倾向，不表示绝对。
phrases.example: Women tend to book earlier than men. 女性往往比男性订得早。

phrases.usage: book 作动词意为“预订”；同族 booking 是名词“预订”。
phrases.example: I booked a flight for Monday. 我订了周一的航班。

pitfalls: than men do 中的 do 不能省，省掉后容易读成“than men”直接跟名词。
airfare 是可数名词，指“机票钱”，不要写成 airfare 单数形式去泛指。
book 在这里是动词“预订”，不是名词“书”。
analysis.paragraphRole: 开篇直接抛出核心发现：女员工机票更便宜，原因在于订得更早。

paragraphs.text: We compared the airfare paid by employees in the same position within a company for the same class of travel and used a common statistical technique to account for other factors that might affect differences in airfares. We found that women paid on average $18 less per ticket than their male colleagues. Further investigation allowed us to conclude that this gap is largely explained by the fact that women tended to book earlier than men, 1.8 days on average.

sentences.text: We compared the airfare paid by employees in the same position within a company for the same class of travel and used a common statistical technique to account for other factors that might affect differences in airfares.

analysis.senseInContext: 机票钱、票价（airfares 复数泛指机票价格）
examples: Airfares rise before holidays. 节假日前机票涨价。

more.confusables: fare 泛指车费/票价；fee 指服务费；price 是价格总称

analysis.senseInContext: （account for）解释、说明；也可表“占（比例）”
examples: This accounts for the difference. 这解释了差异。

more.roots: ac-（向）+ count（计算）→ 算清楚 → 账目、说明
more.confusables: account for 解释/占；take into account 考虑；on account of 因为

analysis.translationLiteral: 我们比较了同一公司内同一职位的员工为同一舱位旅行支付的机票，并使用了一种常见的统计技术来解释可能影响机票差异的其他因素。
analysis.translationNatural: 我们比较了同一公司、同一职位、同一舱位下员工实际支付的票价，又用常见的统计方法把其他可能影响票价的因素排除掉。
analysis.structMarkup: 【We】 _compared_ ~the airfare (paid by employees) (in the same position) (within a company) (for the same class of travel)~ and _used_ ~a common statistical technique~ (to account for other factors {that might affect differences in airfares}).
analysis.structureSummary: 并列谓语：主语 + 谓语1 + 宾语1 + and + 谓语2 + 宾语2 + 目的状语

components.note: 中心词 airfare，后面四个介词/分词短语层层限定
与 compared 并列的第二个谓语
不定式说明用这个技术做什么

components.part: that might affect differences in airfares

clauses: 主句有两个并列谓语：compared 和 used，共用主语 We。
paid by employees in the same position within a company for the same class of travel 是过去分词短语 + 介词短语作后置定语，修饰 airfare。
that might affect differences in airfares 是 that 引导的定语从句，修饰 other factors。
to account for other factors 是不定式作目的状语，不是从句。

phrases.usage: 两个高频义项：account for the difference（解释差异）／account for 30%（占 30%）。
phrases.example: How do you account for the change? 你怎么解释这个变化？

phrases.meaning: 舱位等级（经济舱、商务舱等）
phrases.usage: 航空语境固定说法；同义：cabin class。
phrases.example: They flew in the same class of travel. 他们乘坐同一舱位。

phrases.usage: position 指职位、岗位；同义：at the same level。
phrases.example: Two people in the same position may earn differently. 同一职位的两个人收入可能不同。

pitfalls: account for 有两个常用义（解释／占比例），要按语境判断。
paid by employees 是过去分词短语作定语，不是谓语动词。
定语从句 that might affect... 修饰紧挨着的 other factors，不是 factors 前面的 technique。
analysis.paragraphRole: 交代研究方法与控制变量的做法，为结论的可信度做铺垫。

sentences.text: We found that women paid on average $18 less per ticket than their male colleagues.

examples: She discussed the plan with her colleagues. 她和同事讨论了计划。

more.roots: col-（共同）+ leg（选派）→ 共同被选派 → 同僚
more.confusables: colleague 正式；coworker 更口语；partner 指合伙人

analysis.translationLiteral: 我们发现女性每张票平均比她们的男同事少付 18 美元。
analysis.translationNatural: 结果发现，女员工平均每张票比男同事少花 18 美元。
analysis.structMarkup: 【We】 _found_ ~{that women paid (on average) $18 less (per ticket) (than their male colleagues)}~.
analysis.structureSummary: 主谓 + 宾语从句（从句内部含比较结构）

components.note: 后接 that 宾语从句

components.part: that women paid ... less than their male colleagues

clauses: that women paid... 是 that 引导的宾语从句，作 found 的宾语。
从句内部 than their male colleagues 是比较结构，与 $18 less 呼应。
paid 的宾语是省略的 money，$18 less 是程度修饰。

phrases.usage: 作状语，位置灵活；形容词形式 average（平均的）。
phrases.example: On average, students sleep seven hours. 学生平均睡七小时。

phrases.usage: per 表示“每”，后接单数名词：per person / per day。
phrases.example: The fee is $5 per person. 费用是每人 5 美元。

pitfalls: $18 less 是“少 18 美元”，不要理解成“18 美元以下”。
比较对象要一致：than their male colleagues（与男同事的票价相比），不要写成 than men's。
per ticket 后面不加复数。
analysis.paragraphRole: 给出量化差额，把前面的方法落到具体数字上。

sentences.text: Further investigation allowed us to conclude that this gap is largely explained by the fact that women tended to book earlier than men, 1.8 days on average.

examples: Researchers concluded that sleep affects memory. 研究者得出结论：睡眠影响记忆。

more.roots: con-（完全）+ clud（关闭）→ 关起来 → 结束、得出结论
more.confusables: conclude 还有“结束”义：conclude a speech 结束演讲

analysis.senseInContext: 差距、差额（this gap 指票价差距）
collocations: a gap between A and B
examples: The wage gap remains wide. 工资差距依然很大。

more.confusables: gap 偏“差距/空白”；distance 偏“距离”

analysis.translationLiteral: 进一步调查让我们得出结论：这一差距很大程度上可以用女性比男性更早订票这一事实来解释，平均早 1.8 天。
analysis.translationNatural: 进一步分析后我们判断：这个差价主要是“女性订得更早”造成的，平均早 1.8 天。
analysis.structMarkup: 【Further investigation】 _allowed_ ~us~ (to conclude {that this gap is largely explained by the fact that women tended to book earlier than men, 1.8 days on average}).
analysis.structureSummary: 主谓宾补（allow sb. to do）+ 宾语从句 + 同位语从句

components.note: allow sb. to do 结构
不定式说明“允许我们做什么”

components.part: that this gap is largely explained by the fact
that women tended to book earlier than men
components.note: 解释 the fact 的具体内容

clauses: allow sb. to do sth. 是固定结构：allowed us to conclude（使我们得以得出结论）。
that this gap is largely explained by the fact... 是 that 引导的宾语从句。
that women tended to book earlier than men 是同位语从句，说明 the fact 是什么，不能用 which 替换。
than men 是比较结构，与 earlier 呼应。

phrases.meaning: 使某人能够做某事、允许某人做
phrases.usage: 宾语后必须带 to；同类结构 encourage/force/ask sb. to do。
phrases.example: The data allowed us to draw a conclusion. 这些数据使我们得以得出结论。

phrases.usage: 被动结构；主动形式 explain sth. by sth.。
phrases.example: The difference can be explained by age. 这种差异可以用年龄来解释。

phrases.usage: that 引导同位语从句，说明 fact 的内容；口语中也可省略。
phrases.example: We ignored the fact that prices were rising. 我们忽略了价格在上涨这一事实。

pitfalls: allow sb. to do，不能说 allow sb. do。
the fact that 中的 that 引导同位语从句，不能换成 which。
1.8 days on average 是补充说明“早多少”，不要误当成时间状语修饰整句。
analysis.paragraphRole: 给出关键归因：价差主要来自订票时间的先后，为下文探究“为什么女性订得早”铺路。

paragraphs.text: We wanted to determine what was causing these gender differences in booking business trips so we tested a variety of possible explanations, such as women choosing to plan ahead or male frequent travelers being inclined to book late. None of these explained away the gender gap, so we applied data collected from surveys that express consumer preferences that play a central role in economic decisions, such as patience and risk avoidance.

sentences.text: We wanted to determine what was causing these gender differences in booking business trips so we tested a variety of possible explanations, such as women choosing to plan ahead or male frequent travelers being inclined to book late.

analysis.senseInContext: 确定、查明（determine what was causing... 查明原因）
examples: We need to determine the cause of the error. 我们需要查明错误原因。

more.roots: de-（完全）+ termin（界限）→ 划定界限 → 确定
more.confusables: be determined to do 是“决心做”，与 determine（确定）不同

analysis.translationLiteral: 我们想确定是什么导致了在预订商务旅行方面的这些性别差异，所以我们测试了各种可能的解释，比如女性选择提前计划，或者男性常旅客倾向于晚订。
analysis.translationNatural: 我们想弄清这种订票上的性别差异到底从哪来，于是把各种可能的原因都试了一遍——比如女性更爱提前规划，或者常出差的男性更爱拖到最后订。
analysis.structMarkup: 【We】 _wanted to determine_ ~{what was causing these gender differences in booking business trips}~ {so we tested a variety of possible explanations}, (such as women choosing to plan ahead or male frequent travelers being inclined to book late).
analysis.structureSummary: 主谓宾从句 + 结果状语从句；such as 后接动名词复合结构

components.part: what was causing these gender differences
so we tested a variety of possible explanations
such as women choosing to plan ahead...
components.note: such as 后是动名词复合结构：women + choosing

clauses: what was causing... 是 what 引导的宾语从句，作 determine 的宾语，用陈述语序。
so we tested... 是 so 引导的结果状语从句。
such as 后面并列两个结构：women choosing to plan ahead 与 male frequent travelers being inclined to book late，都是“名词 + 动名词”的复合结构。

phrases.usage: 后接可数名词复数；同义 various。
phrases.example: We tested a variety of options. 我们测试了各种方案。

phrases.usage: 动词短语，ahead 表示“在前面”。
phrases.example: She always plans ahead for exams. 她考试总是提前准备。

phrases.usage: 比 tend to 略正式；incline 作动词表示“倾向”。
phrases.example: He is inclined to agree. 他倾向于同意。

pitfalls: what was causing 用陈述语序，不能写成 what was it causing。
such as 后面的 women choosing 是“名词 + 动名词”，women 不是主句主语。
so 在这里是“因此”，连接两个句子，不是“所以这么”。
analysis.paragraphRole: 交代研究第二步：先排查各种表面解释，为后面的真正变量做铺垫。

sentences.text: None of these explained away the gender gap, so we applied data collected from surveys that express consumer preferences that play a central role in economic decisions, such as patience and risk avoidance.

analysis.senseInContext: 差距、差额（this gap 指票价差距）
collocations: a gap between A and B
examples: The wage gap remains wide. 工资差距依然很大。

more.confusables: gap 偏“差距/空白”；distance 偏“距离”

analysis.translationLiteral: 这些都没有把性别差距解释掉，所以我们采用了从调查中收集的数据，这些调查表达了在经济决策中起核心作用的消费者偏好，比如耐心和规避风险。
analysis.translationNatural: 这些原因都没能解释掉这个差距，于是我们改用问卷数据——这些问卷测的是对经济决策很关键的偏好，比如耐心程度和风险回避倾向。
analysis.structMarkup: 【None of these】 _explained away_ ~the gender gap~, {so we applied} ~data (collected from surveys) {that express consumer preferences} {that play a central role in economic decisions}, (such as patience and risk avoidance).
analysis.structureSummary: 两个并列分句（so 连接结果）+ 两个定语从句 + 举例

components.note: 指上一句列举的各种解释
explain away 意为“把……解释掉（使之不成立）”

components.part: that play a central role in economic decisions

clauses: so 引导结果，连接两个并列分句。
that express consumer preferences 是定语从句，先行词是 surveys。
that play a central role in economic decisions 是定语从句，先行词是 preferences——注意两个 that 修饰的不是同一个词。
collected from surveys 是过去分词短语作后置定语，不是谓语。

phrases.usage: 带贬义色彩，指用解释把问题淡化或消除。
phrases.example: He tried to explain away his mistake. 他试图为自己的错误辩解。

phrases.usage: role 前可换 key/important/vital；也可 play a part in。
phrases.example: Sleep plays a central role in memory. 睡眠对记忆起核心作用。

phrases.usage: 经济学/心理学常用术语；同族 avoid risk。
phrases.example: Risk avoidance shapes many financial choices. 风险回避影响许多财务选择。

pitfalls: explain away 不是“解释”，而是“把……解释掉”，语气不同。
两个 that 从句修饰不同先行词（先 surveys，后 preferences），要顺着读。
None of these 作主语，现代英语谓语可用复数 explained。
analysis.paragraphRole: 排除表面解释，转而引入偏好数据，把分析推向更深的心理变量。

paragraphs.text: We found that only the concept of "negative reciprocity"—in which an employee who feels unfairly treated engages in negative behaviors, such as spending their company's money less carefully—explains these differences. The surveys showed men tend to exhibit more of these negative behaviors than women. This isn't to say that all men engage in these behaviors—or that booking relatively late is a sign of abnormal behavior. It only means that the gender gap disappears when we plug in the negative reciprocity variable.

sentences.text: We found that only the concept of "negative reciprocity"—in which an employee who feels unfairly treated engages in negative behaviors, such as spending their company's money less carefully—explains these differences.

analysis.translationLiteral: 我们发现只有“负互惠”这一概念——即一个感到被不公平对待的员工会采取负面行为，比如不那么小心地花公司的钱——能解释这些差异。
analysis.translationNatural: 我们发现只有一个概念能解释这种差异：“负向互惠”——员工觉得自己被亏待了，就会用消极行为回敬，比如花公司的钱不那么心疼。
analysis.structMarkup: 【We】 _found_ ~{that only the concept of "negative reciprocity"—in which an employee who feels unfairly treated engages in negative behaviors, such as spending their company's money less carefully—explains these differences}~.
analysis.structureSummary: 主谓 + 宾语从句（从句主语带定语从句，谓语 explains）

components.note: 后接 that 宾语从句

components.part: in which an employee ... engages in negative behaviors
components.note: 修饰 concept，说明这个概念是什么
主语是 the concept，故用单数

clauses: that 引导宾语从句，作 found 的宾语。
in which 引导定语从句，修饰 negative reciprocity（= in the concept）。
定语从句内部 who feels unfairly treated 是定语从句，修饰 an employee。
破折号中间整体是插入成分，把主谓分开，阅读时先跳过它能更快抓住主干。

phrases.usage: 后接名词或动名词：engage in business / engage in discussions。
phrases.example: They engaged in a long debate. 他们进行了长时间辩论。

phrases.usage: 社会学/经济学概念，与 positive reciprocity（以德报德）相对。
phrases.example: Negative reciprocity can damage teamwork. 负向互惠会损害团队合作。

phrases.meaning: 花钱不那么仔细、大手大脚
phrases.usage: carefully 修饰 spending；less carefully 表示程度降低。
phrases.example: When rushed, people spend money less carefully. 赶时间时人们花钱更随意。

pitfalls: in which 中的 in 与 concept 搭配（in the concept），不是随意的介词。
engages 的主语是 an employee（单数），explains 的主语是 the concept（单数）——两处都要用单数。
破折号中间很长，先跳过读主干：only the concept ... explains these differences。
analysis.paragraphRole: 给出真正的解释变量“负向互惠”，并给出定义，是全文论证的核心。

sentences.text: The surveys showed men tend to exhibit more of these negative behaviors than women.

analysis.senseInContext: 表现出、显示出（exhibit behaviors 表现出行为）
examples: Some patients exhibit no symptoms. 有些病人没有表现出症状。

more.roots: ex-（向外）+ hibit（持有）→ 拿出来 → 展示
more.confusables: exhibit 较正式；show 最通用；名词 exhibit 指“展品”

analysis.translationLiteral: 调查显示男性比女性更倾向于表现出更多这些负面行为。
analysis.translationNatural: 问卷结果显示，男性比女性更容易出现这类消极行为。
analysis.structMarkup: 【The surveys】 _showed_ ~{men tend to exhibit more of these negative behaviors than women}~.
analysis.structureSummary: 主谓 + 省略 that 的宾语从句（从句内含比较）

components.note: 后接省略 that 的宾语从句
more 是代词，指更多这类行为

clauses: showed 后面省略了连接词 that，引导宾语从句。
than women 是比较结构，与 more 呼应。

phrases.usage: exhibit 较正式，指“展示、表现出”；同义 show / display。
phrases.example: Children exhibit similar patterns of play. 孩子表现出相似的玩耍模式。

pitfalls: showed 后省略 that，不要把 men 当成主句主语。
more of these behaviors 中 more 是代词，不是形容词。
tend to 后接动词原形 exhibit。
analysis.paragraphRole: 用数据支撑上句的概念：男性负向行为更多。

sentences.text: This isn't to say that all men engage in these behaviors—or that booking relatively late is a sign of abnormal behavior.

analysis.senseInContext: 不正常的、反常的（abnormal behavior 异常行为）
examples: The test showed abnormal results. 检查显示了异常结果。

more.roots: ab-（偏离）+ normal（正常）→ 偏离正常
more.confusables: abnormal 偏医学/统计“异常”；unusual 更中性“不寻常”

analysis.translationLiteral: 这并不是说所有男性都有这些行为——或者说相对较晚订票是异常行为的标志。
analysis.translationNatural: 这并不是说所有男性都会这样，也不是说订得晚就是“不正常”。
analysis.structMarkup: 【This】 _isn't_ ~to say {that all men engage in these behaviors}~—or ~{that booking relatively late is a sign of abnormal behavior}~.
analysis.structureSummary: 主系表结构，表语为不定式；两个 that 从句并列作 say 的宾语

components.part: that all men engage in these behaviors
that booking relatively late is a sign of abnormal behavior
components.note: say 的第二个宾语，由 or 并列

clauses: This isn't to say that... 是固定句式：“这并不是说……”。
or 连接两个 that 从句，都作 say 的宾语。
booking relatively late 是动名词短语作第二个从句的主语，谓语用单数 is。

phrases.meaning: 也就是说（此处为否定式 this isn't to say）
phrases.usage: 用于澄清或限定前面的话。
phrases.example: I'm not saying it's easy — that is to say, it takes time. 我不是说这容易，也就是说，它需要时间。

phrases.usage: 后接名词；同义 a signal of / an indication of。
phrases.example: Fatigue is a sign of overwork. 疲劳是过度工作的迹象。

pitfalls: This isn't to say that... 意为“这并不是说”，不是“这不能说”。
or 后的 that 从句同样作 say 的宾语，要一起读。
booking 是动名词作主语，谓语用单数 is。
analysis.paragraphRole: 限定结论边界，避免把统计结论说成对所有人的断言——学术写作的常见严谨表达。

sentences.text: It only means that the gender gap disappears when we plug in the negative reciprocity variable.

analysis.senseInContext: 差距、差额（this gap 指票价差距）
collocations: a gap between A and B
examples: The wage gap remains wide. 工资差距依然很大。

more.confusables: gap 偏“差距/空白”；distance 偏“距离”

analysis.senseInContext: 变量（the negative reciprocity variable 负向互惠变量）
examples: Age is an important variable in the study. 年龄是这项研究中的一个重要变量。

more.confusables: variable 名词“变量”；various 形容词“各种各样的”

analysis.translationLiteral: 它只意味着当我们代入负互惠变量时，性别差距就消失了。
analysis.translationNatural: 它只是说：一旦把“负向互惠”这个变量放进去，性别差异就不见了。
analysis.structMarkup: 【It】 _only means_ ~{that the gender gap disappears when we plug in the negative reciprocity variable}~.
analysis.structureSummary: 主谓 + 宾语从句（从句内含时间状语从句）

components.part: when we plug in the negative reciprocity variable
components.note: 说明在什么条件下差距消失

clauses: that 引导宾语从句，作 means 的宾语。
when 引导时间状语从句，在此也带条件意味（一旦……就）。

phrases.usage: 本义“插电源”，统计语境指“把变量纳入模型”。
phrases.example: Plug in the new figures and see what happens. 把新数据代进去看看结果。

phrases.usage: 常搭 narrow / close / widen the gap。
phrases.example: The gender gap in pay has narrowed. 薪酬上的性别差距已经缩小。

pitfalls: plug in 在此是“代入变量”，不是“插电”。
disappears 的主语是 the gender gap（单数）。
only means 语气上是在收窄结论范围，不要读成“仅仅意味着不重要”。
analysis.paragraphRole: 点明解释力：控制该变量后差异消失，正是“负向互惠”起作用的有力证据。

paragraphs.text: Prior research on negative reciprocity among workers found that it can result in lower employee motivation, business performance and workplace morale and culture.

sentences.text: Prior research on negative reciprocity among workers found that it can result in lower employee motivation, business performance and workplace morale and culture.

analysis.senseInContext: 先前的、在前的（prior research 先前研究）
examples: Prior to 2020, few people worked from home. 2020 年之前，很少有人在家办公。

more.confusables: prior to = before（介词）；prior 作形容词“先前的”

analysis.translationLiteral: 关于员工中负互惠的先前研究发现，它可能导致更低的员工动机、业务绩效以及工作场所的士气和文化的降低。
analysis.translationNatural: 此前关于员工“负向互惠”的研究发现，它会拉低员工积极性、公司业绩，也会损害职场士气与文化。
analysis.structMarkup: 【Prior research (on negative reciprocity among workers)】 _found_ ~{that it can result in lower employee motivation, business performance and workplace morale and culture}~.
analysis.structureSummary: 主谓 + 宾语从句（从句为 result in + 并列名词短语）

components.part: lower employee motivation, business performance and workplace morale and culture
components.note: lower 同时修饰后面四个并列名词

clauses: that it can result in... 是 that 引导的宾语从句，作 found 的宾语。
on negative reciprocity among workers 是介词短语作后置定语，修饰 prior research。

phrases.usage: 学术写作高频；同义 previous research / earlier studies。
phrases.example: Prior research supports this view. 先前研究支持这一观点。

phrases.usage: result in + 结果；result from + 原因，方向相反。
phrases.example: Carelessness results in errors. 粗心导致错误。

phrases.meaning: 职场士气、员工精神面貌
phrases.usage: morale 是不可数名词，指群体士气（与 moral“道德的”拼写不同）。
phrases.example: Low morale hurts productivity. 士气低落损害生产力。

pitfalls: lower 一个词管住后面四个名词（motivation / performance / morale / culture），翻译时都要体现“下降”。
result in（导致）与 result from（起因于）方向相反，别混。
morale（士气）与 moral（道德的）拼写只差一个字母。
analysis.paragraphRole: 引入前人研究，把“负向互惠”的危害从个案提升到已知结论，增强论证分量。

paragraphs.text: Our results show another way these negative behaviors can manifest themselves, like in airline bookings, and add to evidence that women are less likely to engage in them.

sentences.text: Our results show another way these negative behaviors can manifest themselves, like in airline bookings, and add to evidence that women are less likely to engage in them.

analysis.senseInContext: 显现、表现出来（manifest themselves 表现出来）
examples: The disease manifests itself in early childhood. 这种病在幼儿期显现。

more.roots: mani（手）+ fest（抓）→ 用手能抓住 → 明显
more.confusables: manifest 较正式；作形容词意为“明显的”（manifest error）

analysis.senseInContext: 证据（add to evidence that... 为……增添证据）
examples: There is evidence that exercise improves mood. 有证据表明运动能改善情绪。

more.roots: e-（向外）+ vid（看）→ 看得见的东西 → 证据
more.confusables: evidence 不可数，不能说 an evidence；proof 可数

analysis.translationLiteral: 我们的结果显示了这些负面行为可以自我表现的另一种方式，比如在机票预订中，并补充了女性不太可能参与这些行为的证据。
analysis.translationNatural: 我们的结果发现，这类消极行为还有另一种表现途径——订机票；这也为“女性更少这样做”增添了证据。
analysis.structMarkup: 【Our results】 _show_ ~another way (these negative behaviors can manifest themselves)~, (like in airline bookings), and _add to_ ~evidence {that women are less likely to engage in them}~.
analysis.structureSummary: 并列谓语：show + 宾语（带定语从句）；add to + 宾语（带同位语从句）

components.part: these negative behaviors can manifest themselves
components.note: 修饰 way，省略了 that/in which
第二个谓语，与 show 并列

components.part: that women are less likely to engage in them

clauses: these negative behaviors can manifest themselves 是定语从句，先行词是 way（way 后常省略 that 或 in which）。
that women are less likely to engage in them 是同位语从句，解释 evidence 的具体内容。
and 连接两个并列谓语 show 和 add to，共用主语 Our results。

phrases.usage: 反身用法；也可说 manifest itself/themselves。
phrases.example: Stress can manifest itself as headaches. 压力可能表现为头痛。

phrases.usage: add to 后接名词，表示“增加、补充”。
phrases.example: This adds to evidence that sleep matters. 这为“睡眠重要”增添了证据。

phrases.usage: less likely to do 表示“不太可能做”。
phrases.example: Women are less likely to take risks. 女性较少冒险。

pitfalls: way 后面的定语从句省略了 that/in which，别误以为 these behaviors 是主句主语。
add to 是“增加到/增添”，不是“加起来”。
them 指代 these negative behaviors（复数）。
analysis.paragraphRole: 说明本研究的新贡献：把负向互惠的表现延伸到订票这种日常行为，并补充性别差异证据。

paragraphs.text: Companies spend significant sums of money on business travel. While that $18 difference per ticket may seem small, it adds up. Our analysis suggests early booking by women can translate into savings of $1 million a year for a large multinational company with 20,000 regular travelers.

sentences.text: Companies spend significant sums of money on business travel.

analysis.senseInContext: 可观的、显著的（significant sums of money 大量金钱）
examples: There was a significant improvement in scores. 分数有显著提高。

more.roots: sign（标记）+ i + fic（做）+ -ant → 有意义的
more.confusables: significant 在统计语境指“显著的”，不等于“重要的”

analysis.translationLiteral: 公司在商务旅行上花费大量金钱。
analysis.translationNatural: 公司每年在出差上花的钱不是小数目。
analysis.structureSummary: 主谓宾结构 + on 短语作状语（spend money on sth.）

components.note: significant 修饰 sums，表示金额可观
spend money on sth. 的固定搭配

clauses: 本句是简单句，没有从句。

phrases.usage: 介词用 on；也可 spend money (in) doing sth.。
phrases.example: They spend a lot on travel. 他们在差旅上花很多钱。

phrases.usage: sum 指一笔钱；significant sums 表示数额巨大。
phrases.example: Large sums of money were invested. 投入了大笔资金。

pitfalls: spend 的搭配是 spend money on sth.，不要用 spend money in sth.。
sums 用复数，因为说的是多笔支出。
analysis.paragraphRole: 把讨论从“行为差异”引向“经济意义”，为结尾的金额估算铺垫。

sentences.text: While that $18 difference per ticket may seem small, it adds up.

analysis.translationLiteral: 虽然每张票 18 美元的差异看起来很小，但它会累积起来。
analysis.translationNatural: 单张票差 18 美元看着不多，可架不住量大，累积起来很可观。
analysis.structMarkup: {While that $18 difference (per ticket) may seem small}, 【it】 _adds up_.
analysis.structureSummary: 让步状语从句 + 主句

components.part: While that $18 difference per ticket may seem small

components.note: seem 是系动词，后接形容词
add up 意为“累积起来”

clauses: while 引导让步状语从句，意为“虽然、尽管”（不是“当……时”）。
主句 it adds up 与从句形成转折关系。

phrases.meaning: 累积、加总起来（数目可观）
phrases.usage: 不及物用法：small savings add up（小钱攒起来很可观）。
phrases.example: Small daily costs add up quickly. 每天的小额开支很快累积起来。

phrases.usage: seem 是系动词，后接形容词或 to be。
phrases.example: The task seems easy at first. 这任务一开始看起来很容易。

pitfalls: while 有两个常用义（虽然／当……时），此处是“虽然”。
adds up 是不及物短语，后面不接宾语。
it 指代的是“差额”这一概念，不是 companies。
analysis.paragraphRole: 转折强调：单笔差额虽小，但乘以规模后意义重大。

sentences.text: Our analysis suggests early booking by women can translate into savings of $1 million a year for a large multinational company with 20,000 regular travelers.

examples: Good planning translates into better results. 好的规划会转化为更好的结果。

more.roots: trans-（跨越）+ lat（搬运）→ 搬过去 → 翻译/转化
more.confusables: translate into 既可是“翻译成”，也可是“转化为”，看语境

analysis.senseInContext: 跨国的（a large multinational company 大型跨国公司）
examples: Multinational firms face complex tax rules. 跨国企业面临复杂的税务规则。

more.confusables: multinational 强调在多国经营；international 泛指国际的

analysis.translationLiteral: 我们的分析表明，女性的提前预订可以为一家拥有 2 万名常旅客的大型跨国公司转化为每年 100 万美元的节省。
analysis.translationNatural: 我们的分析显示：对一家有两万名常出差员工的大型跨国企业来说，女性这种提前订票的习惯一年能省下 100 万美元。
analysis.structMarkup: 【Our analysis】 _suggests_ ~{early booking by women can translate into savings of $1 million a year for a large multinational company (with 20,000 regular travelers)}~.
analysis.structureSummary: 主谓 + 省略 that 的宾语从句（从句为主谓宾 + for 状语）

components.note: 后接省略 that 的宾语从句
每年 100 万美元的节省

components.part: for a large multinational company with 20,000 regular travelers
components.note: 说明对谁而言；with 短语作定语修饰 company

clauses: suggests 后省略了连接词 that，引导宾语从句。
with 20,000 regular travelers 是介词短语作后置定语，修饰 a large multinational company。
early booking by women 是动名词短语作从句主语，谓语用单数 can translate。

phrases.usage: 此处不是“翻译”；常指投入转化为产出。
phrases.example: Hard work translates into results. 努力会转化为成果。

phrases.usage: savings 用复数，指节省下来的钱。
phrases.example: The change led to savings of $500. 这项改变节省了 500 美元。

phrases.usage: multinational 可作形容词或名词；常缩略为 MNC。
phrases.example: She works for a multinational company. 她在一家跨国公司工作。

pitfalls: translate into 在此是“转化为”，不能译成“翻译成”。
savings 必须用复数；saving 单数是“节约（行为）”。
early booking by women 作主语，谓语不能用复数。
analysis.paragraphRole: 给出经济价值估算，为全文收尾，把行为差异提升到企业成本层面。

questions.stem: What did the author's team conclude about the gender difference in airfares from their further investigation?

options.text: It is largely attributed to women booking earlier than men.
It is largely explained by women's choosing cheaper flights.
It is mainly accounted for by male employees' readiness to pay more.
It is due to the fact that women care more about their company's money.

questions.stem: What did the researchers want to determine by testing a variety of possible explanations?

options.text: What made male frequent travelers book air tickets late.
What caused women to plan ahead in booking business trips.
What motivated women to book cheaper flights.
What accounted for the gender gap in airfares.

questions.stem: What happened when the negative reciprocity variable was taken into account?

options.text: Both men and women were found to engage in negative behaviors.
Neither men nor women viewed booking late as a bad behavior.
The gender difference in airfare expenses no longer existed.
The gender gap tended to narrow to a significant degree.

questions.stem: What did prior research on negative reciprocity among workers find?

options.text: It can do more harm to the workplace than to employees.
It contributes to the male-female divide in the workplace.
It proves to be counterproductive in a number of ways.
It can result in increasing labor-management conflicts.

questions.stem: What does the author emphasize about their analysis in the last paragraph?

options.text: It can help companies increase their savings significantly.
It can duly contribute to companies' business performance.
It can translate women's booking practice into men's behavior.
It can enhance large multinational companies' competitiveness.
